expected: Replace the 'unrecorded use = unresolved gap' rule with evidence-based outcomes.
lesson: Four outcomes: exhausted on a date; within (order date, R]; not in force with use unknown as an interval to the reason date; open. Most waivers will stay open on use unless the Official Register is fetched (archive.org/HathiTrust were unreachable from the cloud session; a GitHub job may reach them).
result: CSC annual reports print and count waivers but never record use (four read in full). Use can be dated by the Official Register (odd years 1901-1921, an interval) or later orders naming the person; NARA St. Louis cards are offline. No general rewrite (EO 7916, 8743, 9830, 10577) ends these waivers; EO 3461 (1921) expressly revokes listed war-emergency appointment orders; EO 209 (1903) is a reason only for 1900-02 special rules; latest possible death bounds the end only when a quoted fact fixes a minimum age. Reviewers found misclassified members (rule amendments, class orders, land orders). Rule approved after R5-R7.
